span.p: An object arrives from the pipeline

div.style: color: rgb(59, 35, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Can the object itself bind to a parameter
that has ValueFromPipeline?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 30) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
By value
the whole object becomes the parameter value

div.style: color: rgb(59, 35, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does the object have a property with the name
or alias of a parameter that has
ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 30) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
By property name
the property value becomes the parameter value

div.style: color: rgb(92, 0, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Error
the input object cannot be bound

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 40) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(31, 35, 40) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Get-ChildItem -Directory | Get-LargestFile -Top 1
the PSPath property binds to -LiteralPath
through its alias PSPath
